items.html: And this is the secret of "May the name of God be blessed" — that it is Malchut, called the name of God. "May He be blessed" — Mem-Beit on its head, as is known that the forty-two-letter name is on the head, as mentioned in the Book of Tikkunim, Tikkun 70. And it is the matter of the judgments that are given in the head of the Nukva on this day, called the forty-two-letter name, which is Gevura, as is known.
